flows.narrative: Re-verified Nov 8: no newer Lipper/EPFR/BofA Flow Show cut exists yet covering Thursday Nov 5's AI-capex-driven reversal -- the next cut (week ending Nov 11) is expected ~Nov 13-14, so this remains the week-ending-Nov-4 cut. It showed a 7th straight week of global equity inflows (+$38.63B, largest since Sept 23) alongside a record $117.97B flood into US money-market funds -- a barbell of still-buying-stocks-but-raising-cash that reads as hedging into the midterm/AI-capex uncertainty rather than a clean risk-on or risk-off signal. Re-verified Mon 9 Nov: no newer Lipper/EPFR/BofA Flow Show cut exists yet (next cut, week ending Nov 11, still expected ~Nov 13-14). Supplementary global-scope EPFR/BofA figures for the SAME week-ended-Nov4 period (broader than the US/DM/EM regional splits above, not additive to them) show global equity funds' 7th straight week of inflows (+$38.63B), EM's 5th straight week, global bond funds +$9.91B and global money-market funds +$172.71B -- consistent with, not contradicting, the region-level barbell picture already on file.
